The primary provider that takes precedence for POSIX user attributes in case of conflict between two providers
that both have POSIX user attributes (optional filter)

options.name: preferred_owning_group
options.description: Set to prefer GID of the user as the owning group of the file (optional filter)

options.name: require_smb_signing
options.description:
Require SMB clients to perform SMB message signing. SMB messages with invalid or missing signatures will be
blocked. (optional filter)

options.name: smb_administrators_group_name
options.description:
Optional custom name to specify a non default privileged group. If not set, privileged group is the
BUILTIN\\Administrators group. (optional filter)

options.name: smb_allowed
options.description: Filter by smb allowed (optional filter)

options.name: smb_encryption_state
options.description: Defines the encryption level for SMB (optional filter)

options.name: smb_privileged_group_full_access
options.description: If true, the privileged group has full access. Otherwise, read only (optional filter)

options.name: smb_privileged_group_sid
options.description:
Optional custom SID to specify a non default SMB privileged group. If not set, SMB privileged group is the Backup
Operators domain group. (optional filter)

options.name: smb_privileged_user_name
options.description:
Optional custom username for the SMB privileged user. If not set, the SMB privileged user name is 'vastadmin'
(optional filter)

options.name: sync
options.description: Synchronization state with leader (optional filter)

options.name: sync_time
options.description: Synchronization time with leader (optional filter)

options.name: tenant_admins_group_name
options.description:
Sets a group on an AD or LDAP provider. Enables users in the group to log into the tenant VMS as Tenant Admin
users. Tenant Admin is a type of VMS manager user that has management access to a specific tenant's VMS.
(optional filter)

options.name: title
options.description: Filter by title (optional filter)

options.name: trash_gid
options.description:
GID of group of NFSv3 users that have permission to move files into the trash folder. If not set, the operation
of moving files into the trash folder is supported for the root user only. (optional filter)

options.name: url
options.description: Filter by url (optional filter)

options.name: use_smb_native
options.description:
Access check decisions will be made based on user and group information from the Kerberos ticket. Use this if
your Active Directory has a one-way trust. This is relevant for SMB only. (optional filter)

options.name: use_smb_privileged_group
options.description: If true, the privileged group is enabled (optional filter)

options.name: use_smb_privileged_user
options.description: If true, the privileged user is enabled (optional filter)
